statements.impact_statement: Code Polishy invokes Trivy only for its version command, an anonymous database download, and offline Docker-archive scans; binary reachability analysis found no vulnerable os.Root symbols.
The scanner never pushes registry blobs or receives registry credentials; its only networked action is an anonymous database download with no mounted scan input or credentials.
The scanner receives local Docker image archives with --input and --offline-scan; it never invokes ORAS artifact pull or unpack.
Every scanned archive is captured locally from a declared artifact target; parsing is networkless, resource-bounded, and capped by a ten-minute timeout.
The scanner does not run an xDS RBAC service or a gRPC HTTP/2 server; offline scans have no network, and database download receives no untrusted mounts or credentials.
